# Prodhosh VS (thecodeguy): full profile

Source: https://links.prodhosh.me/ (links hub). Main site: https://prodhosh.me. Last updated: 2026-11-02.

## Who he is
Prodhosh VS (also written Prodhosh V S, handle "thecodeguy", GitHub "PRODHOSH") is a full-stack developer and product builder based in Chennai, India. He is the founding engineer at BS Prep. He builds end-to-end products that scale: Next.js on the front, Postgres and Supabase underneath, and LLMs wired in where they help.

Roles: Founding Engineer, Freelancer, Product Builder, SDE aspirant.
Core stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, GitHub API, Framer Motion.

## Experience
### BS Prep, Founding Engineer (Jan 2026 to present), https://bsprep.in
Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Razorpay.
- Leads engineering for a student-built exam prep platform for IIT Madras BS: Tamil video courses, live classes, quizzes, GPA tools, an in-browser compiler (Python, Java, C, C++) and an AI doubt assistant. Shipped 4 products on one stack.
- Reached 500+ daily active users and 5,000+ site visitors; secured 5 corporate sponsorships for the Ambassador program.
- Payments use server-side Razorpay orders and signature checks.

## Featured projects
### GSSoC Tracker, https://gssoc-tracker.vercel.app (code on GitHub)
Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, GitHub API, PostgreSQL.
- A faster alternative to the official GSSoC 2026 leaderboard (56,000 participants) with PR scoring, rankings, analytics and email alerts when a score changes. Prodhosh ranked #932 of 56,000 in the same program.
- Serves 3,000+ users and 150,000+ contribution events; rated 4.7/5 in user feedback; 100+ GitHub stars.

### Quarry UI, https://quarry-ui.vercel.app (code on GitHub, MIT license)
Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, shadcn registry.
- Open-source library of 86 animated React components, 4 full app templates, 13 live backgrounds, 18 loaders and 78 brand design-system briefs, installable with a single shadcn CLI command.
